'''Sposia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Sposia system/Legends|Sposia system]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Path of the Houses]] linked it to the [[Csilla system/Legends|Csilla]] and [[Naporar system/Legends|Naporar systems]]. Sposia was home to [[Sabosen family|House Sabosen]], one of the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and it was the site of the Chiss Ascendancy's top academies and [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenters]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sposia was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square F-8.<ref name="TEA" />
